data.narrative:
Stratek Global is a growth-stage nuclear energy company founded by Kelvin Kemm. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 8 firms across the nuclear sector: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 5 private peers (Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, Blue Energy).

The peer-median method was not applicable to this analysis. The nuclear energy sector contains only 4 same-sector comparables, but none satisfied the filtering criteria for stage alignment, adjacent-stage proximity, or valuation-tier similarity required to establish a meaningful peer set of three or more firms. Applying an all-sector median would risk introducing material distortion given the heterogeneity of business models and development timelines within nuclear technology.

Without sufficient narrow-set comparable data, this analysis cannot support a triangulated valuation range at this time. The primary constraint is the limited depth of private or public firms at equivalent growth stages with sufficiently homogeneous operating profiles. Future valuation work would benefit from either: (1) expanded tracking of the private nuclear cohort as it matures, or (2) staged analysis using revenue multiples or development-milestone frameworks if revenue or funding-round data becomes available. Current public market pricing of the identified three tickers may offer directional context but cannot serve as primary benchmarks without stage and scale reconciliation.
